card.name: Inside accented Spanish and Portuguese names
card.fires_on: The piece right after an accented letter inside a foreign personal or place name, such as Antón-io, Á-lv-ares, Domí-ng-uez, or Hungarian names like Bálvány. Seen in web text about Iberian or Hungarian people and places.

card.writes: It promotes endings typical of accented Spanish and Portuguese words, such as -ulas, -ico, -icos and -icamente.
card.plain: It fires in the middle of foreign names with accented letters, like António or Álvares, where the name is not yet finished.
